routes.notes: Doses are mg of Δ9-THC, not flower weight. Flower needed ≈ desired THC ÷ strain %THC; smoking loses ~50–80% to combustion, so real flower amounts run higher.
Doses are mg of Δ9-THC (edibles/oils). Oral THC has low, variable bioavailability and converts to stronger 11-OH-THC; wait ≥2 h before any redose.

combinations.name: CNS depressants
combinations.description: Alcohol, benzodiazepines, opioids — sedation adds up. With alcohol especially, dizziness and nausea multiply into 'the spins', and drinking first raises THC absorption. Keep one of them light.

combinations.name: Psychedelics
combinations.description: Cannabis reliably strengthens LSD and psilocybin, and a normal dose mid-trip can restart the peak. It's the most common factor in difficult trips. If you add it, use a fraction of your usual amount.
